rule_text: Distribution center DC 0042 (Columbus, OH) closed on 2026-09-01. Any order addressed to DC 0042 must ship to DC 0047 (Groveport, OH) instead.
Meridian buysheet quantities are always in CASES. Multiply by the SKU case pack to get eaches.
When Corso Profumerie omits the size, a fragrance means the 100 ml and a skincare product means the 50 ml.
Lines marked FOC (free of charge) on Harlow & Vale orders are free goods: price 0, item category FREE. They still consume inventory.
Pharmacie Lumen uses French formats: decimal comma (12,50), DD/MM/YYYY dates. 'EAN' is the GTIN-13.
Northbay Drug sends back the full Maison Solenne price list. Only rows with Order Qty > 0 are ordered.
Kensington Salon Supply means the salon size (1 L / 500 ml Salon) of Mistral Hair products unless the caller says 'retail' or gives a size.
BeautyHaus Online often orders superseded material codes. If the code is discontinued, substitute the successor material.
Al Noor Trading prices are in AED. If a price is missing, use the contracted AED price list.
Glow Republic lines described 'PROMO - NO CHARGE' are free goods (price 0, item category FREE).
A requested delivery date on a weekend moves to the next Monday. A date already in the past means 'as soon as possible' and must be flagged for review.
If the price on a PO differs from the contracted net price by more than 2%, the contracted price wins and the line must be reviewed by Finance.
On a Maison Solenne promo form (Aktionsformular) the net price is the printed EK minus the discount in the orange badge (e.g. RR 15%). It overrides the contract price list for that order.
The Kunden-Nr. handwritten on promo forms is the Maison Solenne sold-to number. If it is missing, identify the customer from the shop stamp.
'+1 Tester' (or 'TESTER') means one free tester unit of that product: separate line, tester material, price 0, item category FREE.
A handwritten or sticky-note delivery instruction ('bitte an Filiale … liefern', 'ship to …') overrides the default ship-to for that order.
Retailers sometimes resend the same PO through a second channel (e.g. email then fax). The same retailer + PO number must never create two sales orders.
